title: Comments of Friends of the Earth US et al. re the Green Chile Gas Pipeline Project under CP26-80.

documents.text:
Attached, please find the signatures of 14,662 Friends of the Earth supporters:



Re: Please reject approvals for the Green Chile Project



I am writing with deep concern regarding the Environmental Assessment of the Green Chile
Project, proposed by Transwestern Pipeline Company, LLC (Transwestern).

The project in question will further entrench polluting gas infrastructure that negatively
impacts communities and our planet by incentivizing continued and expanding fossil fuel
use. At a time when the climate crisis is worsening, we should be looking to embrace
sustainable forms of energy like wind or solar rather than doubling down on dirty forms of
energy that pollute our communities and contribute to climate chaos.

Furthermore, communities across the country are being impacted by the completely
unregulated deployment of massive data center projects that are straining our water
resources, spiking our energy bills, worsening the climate crisis, and disrupting the fabric of
our communities. This pipeline would enable a data center project in New Mexico that
could have serious consequences for local communities.

Please protect New Mexico residents and the planet by reject the Green Chile Project.



Thank you.
